warnings: Cover page: a painted perspective render with the Thai caption 'บ้านผู้ประสบภัย ๓' only. No title block, no sheet code, no dimensions, no grid.

The render confirms the building form read off the structural sheets: a long single-storey row building with a continuous gable roof, a full-length front walkway with railing, and a central entrance stair -- consistent with the 10-column-line steel portal frame on S-02.
